overall: MARGINAL: OK this afternoon, wind back on the south grounds and Ciron tonight
limiterDetail: Main limiter: wind plus rain. Wind (E–ESE, sustained per ECMWF) is 8.5–14 kt now and dips to ~9–11 kt by ~5–8 PM, then rebuilds from ~9–10 PM: Ciron 14.4–16.5 kt and Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot 13–15.6 kt through Fri morning. Showers come in two bursts: now–5 PM in the west (Linapacan and Alava ~2.4 mm/h) and ~6–9 PM across all grounds (Nangalao heaviest at ~4.2 mm/h). Currents are mild (0.1–0.6 kt now).

pagasa.detail: PAGASA: CLEAR · nothing active for Calamian / MIMAROPA. No new entries since this morning; the latest (Thu 5:13–5:27 AM PHT) are flood advisories for Visayas and Mindanao regions. The feed's related MIMAROPA item (Region 4-B) is GFA #2, marked Final.

changed.title: ⚠️ What changed since this morning
items: Sunday's recovery slipped a day: Sun 18 dropped from GOOD to MARGINAL on rain (~11.8 mm, was ~7.5), even though wind is light (4.7 kt, gusts 13). Only Mon 19 (still the best day) and Tue 20 are GOOD now, so the refill of stock moves from Sunday evening to Monday evening and the thin stretch now runs Fri–Sun.

This afternoon is easier than this morning. No ground is POOR on wind any more (4 were at 6 AM): Ciron is down to 13.8 kt and Nangalao to 11.9. Tara, Turda and Decabobo are GOOD (was only Decabobo). Linapacan is the one POOR ground, on heavy rain (~2.4 mm/h until ~5 PM). Today's rain total went up to ~13.3 mm (was ~8.0).

Also: Fri 16 is drier (~5.3 mm, was ~8.7) but gustier (19 kt, was 17); Sat 17 is wetter (~9.6 mm, was ~6.0). GFS now materially disagrees on wind (7.9 vs ECMWF 12.9 kt now), so tonight's wind numbers are the cautious side.

bestWindow.headline: Now–~5 PM (Decabobo, Tara, Turda) · Fri ~1–8 AM (Decabobo, Turda, Tara, Coron, Galoc)
details: Now–~5 PM on Decabobo, Tara and Turda: wind 6.5–8.5 kt, currents 0.0–0.5 kt, light rain (≤0.5 mm/h). Get back before the ~6–9 PM showers (~1.5 mm/h), when Tara and Turda currents also pick up to 0.7–0.9 kt.

Fri ~1–8 AM: Decabobo is nearly slack (0.1–0.2 kt) with 4.8–6.4 kt wind, and Turda's current falls to 0.1–0.3 kt in the same light wind (Tara 0.3–0.5). All three are dry from ~3 AM. Coron and Galoc are at their calmest, 6.8–9.0 kt, with currents 0.0–0.5 kt and Coron near slack ~7–9 AM. The model's single best hour in the next 24h is Fri ~noon at Decabobo (3.9 kt, current 0.0 kt, dry). The model rates the next 24h POOR overall because of the south and Ciron; Decabobo is the best spot.

Keep boats off Ciron from ~10 PM to Fri noon (14.3–16.5 kt), and off Nangalao, Cabunlawan and Decabaitot tonight and Fri morning (13–15.6 kt, plus heavy showers 6–9 PM). Alava's current picks up to 0.8–1.0 kt Fri ~2–5 AM with 12–13 kt wind.
